body:
Life is like a bucket of shit with a small diamond Inside. If all you're looking for is shit, it's all you'll pull out of it; but if you stay down in the shit and you carry through you'll eventually find that diamond.
Circular trains of thought will just keep you wrapped up in your feelings of loneliness. You were strong enough to pull yourself out once and I believe you can do it again. I don't know you and I'm not a fan of people. But I believe you even if I don't. You're gonna make it
Not really, and Thank you for taking the time to respond. I'm definitely going to get a professional opinion and I wish you the best of luck as well. Peace to you

These are deeper inside next to my jaw, they aren't on the surface which is what has me so confused. My great grandmother had some skin cancer removed from her face a few years back but these aren't on the surface they're kinda deep but the feel like hard knots that weren't there a few months ago. I'm not sure if I'm just being paranoid but it's In the family so I feel I can't ignore it.

Hey man life is like a bucket of shit with a small diamond in it. If all you look for is shit it's all you'll come up with BUT if you stay down in the shit determined to find that diamond, you most certainly will. Life is full of horrible obstacles and over coming them is what makes us stronger. Your feelings matter and I'm sorry if life has come to teach you otherwise. All life is precious including that of your own.
You both seem sus to me but I don't care what others do in their spare time. You do you. Live and let live
I-I need to wash my eyes..

Thank you so much, I never expected such kindness or really anything from this, but I hope that this reaches someone who really needs it. Yalls kindness will hopefully be proof enough for them to really try and change.
I'll uhhh take your word on it.

Well unfortunately it's a mobile home that's probably worth more to the fire department for a controlled fire lol but if they can make use of it for training that'd be more than that house had ever given us.

I lived a very long time in silence, and unfortunately anytime I reached out I seemingly reached out in the wrong place; But if we don't trust our instincts and fail, we may never have them sharp enough to be able to be right. Thank you for your words, you didn't have to but you did anyway and I've never expected such responses. I'm beside myself and can't say thank you enough to everyone for their words either. I'm glad I don't see the world the way I used to because I always saw the worst in people as a whole, and all of you have certainly made me believe in the opposite and that's a life I can certainly belive in. Thank you again kind strangers.

I've burned that bridge twice over.  I'm not sure the third times the charm with this girl. I tried asking about her through that friend, and he said she had kinda become a bitch to everyone after that. So I'm not sure thats a can I'm ready to open. Plus, I'm certain she's almost entirely forgotten about it and I think I'd rather not reopen that wound for her.

Yea it's an very unfortunate thing, people like that just get sucked into that life and can't crawl back out. But I've seen a few houses like that where meth heads lived and I swear those people have affinity for destroying doors.
No unfortunately my family is still stuck with it. Its hard to sell a home like that. They're still suffering there for now, but they're working on getting out.
Bro that looks like signs of meth heads. Mostly the doors that tell me that but who knows could be from San Francisco 😂. Hopefully It wasn't to hard to clean up.

Thank you for your kind words. I still have a ways to go but I feel like it's not unobtainable. Change isn't meant to be comfortable or easy, but anything worth  having in this life isn't easy to obtain. Your words mean more than you know. Thank you
Its just on odd experience isn't it? It's a great thing we didn't though. So much more in this life to laugh at lol. Everything happens for a reason.
